From: Emily Carter <emily.carter@gartner.com>

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Participation request: 'Cloud inference in regulated healthcare' briefing

Hi Rishi / Marissa,

I'm putting together a short analyst briefing (30 minutes) on 'Cloud inference in regulated healthcare' for a small group of healthcare CIOs and security leads next month. We'd love to feature MediWell as a customer example to discuss: deployment model (private vs hosted), latency SLAs, and how you handle auditing / SOC2 evidence for inference workloads.

Would MediWell be open to a 30-min call (analyst + customer + vendor) the week of Sep 7? On the call we typically ask for a quick description of the architecture, 1–2 metrics (e.g., 95th percentile latency and average throughput), and a short one-line quote we can attribute to the customer. We also need explicit permission to use the MediWell logo in any briefing slides.

Proposed slots:
- Tue Sep 8, 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Sep 9, 13:00–13:30 PT

I've attached a short agenda and a consent template (briefing_agenda.pdf, analyst_consent_form.docx) — happy to adapt. If helpful, the vendor (Redwood) can share a draft quote for the customer to edit.

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Carter
Senior Analyst, Enterprise Apps
Gartner Inc.
emily.carter@gartner.com
